jamie (docs): Quick ping — noticed a 404 in docs/runtime/debugging.md at the cURL example. The link to https://dl.redwood.ai/samples/debugging/curl returns 404. Can someone patch?

arjun (eng-runtime): Thanks — that URL got moved during the artifact reorg last week. New path is https://downloads.redwood.ai/examples/curl-debugging. I can open a tiny PR to update the link + the snippet to the latest host.

jamie (docs): Please also add a one-line backcompat note about the old host so folks who copied earlier examples don't get confused.

maria (oncall): Also the snippet still uses `-H 'X-Api-Key: $API_KEY'` which we replaced with `Authorization: Bearer ...` in the public samples. Suggest updating the example to: 

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```

arjun (eng-runtime): Good catch — will include that and a short note about region subdomains for Private deployments. I'll open PR and link it here.

jamie (docs): Thanks — if you can, tweak the frontmatter to bump the last-updated date too.

arjun (eng-runtime): PR opened and includes the link + header fix + backcompat sentence + frontmatter date: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

deploy-bot: link-checker: ran on PR 1234 — flagged 1 missing image, 0 broken links in the updated file :white_check_mark:

tina (engineer): if you're touching the snippet, can you also add a short streaming hint (`?stream=true`) or an `Accept: text/event-stream` note? Users often copy the non-streaming example and get confused.

arjun (eng-runtime): Will do — added a streaming example and a one-line note about region hosts and header format. Pushed and merged. Thanks everyone :tada:
